title: murraya kwangsiensis
intro: Murraya kwangsiensis, commonly known as the Orange Jessamine, is a flowering plant in the Rutaceae family native to southern China and Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Murraya kwangsiensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Murraya kwangsiensis include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
